newsitem.title: USA: J&L Specialty Steel delays price hikes.
newsitem.headline: J&L Specialty Steel delays price hikes.

text.p: J&L Specialty Steel Inc said Thursday that it is delaying a price increase it originally set for May 4 until June 1.

The company had planned to increase its steel prices by decreasing market discounts by three percentage points on all 200, 300 and 400 series grades of stainless sheet and strip and continuous mill plate products after May 4.
It had also planned to cut discounts on stainless steel commodity products and hot rolled products.
A company spokesman said the decision was due to the competitive pressures in the North American marketplace.
